pages.text: This guide writes programs as text. Each text line is one line on the sheet. Four spaces mean one block further east (to the right).

Words in capitals like $(1)FUNCTION$() are keyword blocks. Lowercase names are LABEL blocks. Numbers and text in quotes are LITERAL blocks. Symbols like $(1)+$(), $(1)⊕$() and $(1);$() are OPERATOR blocks.$(br2)$(1)//$() stands for a COMMENT block. The text after it is the comment.
